Mira Chen: Heads-up, hit a weird edge with JSON mode + function/tool calls in the sample app. Repro is pretty consistent locally. :bug:
Mira Chen: Env: JS SDK v0.14.2, Python SDK v0.9.1, model=gpt-x, json_mode=true, schema validator enabled, function_call=auto. Python + hosted return proper tool args object, JS path returns a quoted string that breaks the tool runner.
Mira Chen: Minimal repro payload (trimmed):
```json
{
  \"json_mode\": true,
  \"function_call\": \"auto\",
  \"schema\": { \"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": { \"id\": {\"type\": \"integer\"} } }
}
```
Mira Chen: Behavior: when auth refresh triggers (401 -> refresh -> retry), the JS SDK appears to double-serialize the function args. Example wire-level tool message we saw:
`{\"role\":\"tool\",\"name\":\"get_user\",\"content\":\"\\\"{\\\\\\\"id\\\\\\\":123,\\\\\\\"meta\\\\\\\":{\\\\\\\"src\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"ok\\\\\\\"}}\\\"\"}`
Raf Patel: Which retry middleware? SDK built-in or our wrapper?
Mira Chen: Our middleware that refreshes token then retries the original request (request -> 401 -> refresh -> retry(original payload)).
Nate Williams: Ive seen this: if the SDK stringifies lazily and retry reuses the already-stringified body, double-stringify can happen. Short fix: ensure transport does final stringify and retry clones pre-serialization state.
Raf Patel: Can you paste the raw send logs and confirm disabling json_mode changes it?
Mira Chen: Logs:
> SEND (post): {json_mode:true, function_call:auto} -> body (js-sdk): `{"function_call":"auto","args":"{\"id\":123}"}`
> MODEL RESP: returns object, but on retry the helper treats the string as pre-serialized and wraps it again. Disabling json_mode removes the quoting issue.
Nate Williams: Workaround: in middleware, on retry rehydrate parsed objects instead of reusing stringified body. Or disable json coercion for that endpoint.
Anya K: Filing INC-3921 with repro + logs. I'll branch a hotfix to prevent SDK helper from re-serializing on retry. Assigning @Mira Chen to validate.
devx-bot: CI kicked: https://ci.redwood/example/1965/build/1234 - running integration tests that exercise the sample-app flow.
Raf Patel: Long-term: make serialization a single-step at transport boundary and make retries operate on pre-serialization clones. I'll write an RFC.
Mira Chen: Thanks all 1 will try Nate's workaround and validate the hotfix. Adding an integration test and a note in sample-app README. :+1:
